notes.matching: match(): largest grid point with C <= C_ref, then linear interpolation towards the next point to C = C_ref; flags if out of range.
notes.rule_A_grid: 80 quantiles 0.0125..1.0 of distances of paraphrased inputs (both pivots, 700 evaluation tasks) to own signature, per ruler
notes.diagnostic_ratio: mean own-signature distance of paraphrased inputs (both pivots) / mean nearest-other-signature distance, among the 700 evaluation signatures
notes.Sigma_p: uncentred mean of d d^T, d = phi_nk(German paraphrase) - phi_nk(original), first 3 inputs of each of 175 calibration tasks
notes.T5: T5EncoderModel shared embedding table; tokenizer appends </s>, pad id 0 has weight 0
notes.secondary_radius: NEW beta 0.1 uses the rule-A matched radius of the French-pivot set (same radius for all tasks)
